reply.text:
Fifteen pounds in a week isn't something I'll help you chase. The fast ways to do it mean cutting food hard or dropping water, and that is one to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian before the wedding. I'm not going to set a target or build anything for it.

What I can do is help you feel strong and sharp on the day. A solid session or two this week, good sleep and steady meals will do more for how you look and feel in photos than any crash would. Want me to set up a session for today?
